target_anomaly: Intermittent lock wait timeout on a daily DELETE due to a long-lived transaction holding row locks on the same qualifying `EVENT_DETAILS` range
dba_description: Random lock wait timeouts occur on a daily DELETE from `EVENT_DETAILS` while other sessions remain open for a long time. The suspected mechanism is a long-running write transaction that holds row locks on the same predicate range, causing the DELETE to wait on the hidden clustered index until lock_wait_timeout expires.
target_path: Daily DELETE scans the same `UPDATE_DATE`/`COMPONENT_NAME` range
DELETE waits on the hidden clustered index and times out
